content: No major vendor markets an explicit nested or hierarchical roles primitive, e.g. a role that automatically inherits eligibility for all roles below it. All surveyed products, When I Work, Skedulo, Legion, Humanity, Deputy, implement qualification as a FLAT set of independent tags, skills or badges assigned per person, with hierarchy, if any, emulated by giving one person multiple tags rather than the system understanding a containment relationship. This corroborates rejecting a hierarchy primitive: the market has converged on flat sets as sufficient, even for verticals such as field service and healthcare that clearly have graded skill levels.
